description: This Java source file defines the DateDatatype class, a custom datatype for handling dates (without time) within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It extends SerializingCustomDatatype, providing methods for serializing, deserializing, and summarizing Date objects.

classes.name: DateDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for handling date values (without time) in OpenMRS, supporting serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Returns a textual summary of the date value, formatted using the system's date format.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a serialized date string back into a Date object, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a Date object into its string representation using the specified format.
